- Migrated most remaining Java code to idiomatic Kotlin.

If you appreciate my work, you can show your support with a [donation through Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/nielsvanvelzen) or [GitHub sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/nielsvanvelzen). Your support helps me continue improving and growing the app. Thank you!

> **Note:** This version will not be published to the Google Play store.

## 🔧 Bugfixes

- Immediately load device information in nativeshell #1943, by [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)

## Contributors

- [@nielsvanvelzen](https://github.com/nielsvanvelzen)

- Full Changelog: https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/compare/v0.3.14.250932...v0.3.15.250932

## Release artifacts
- Users on devices with an aftermarket custom operating system ("Custom ROM") that supports microG should install `com.google.android.gms-250932030.apk` and `com.android.vending-84022630.apk`. These versions are also distributed through the microG F-Droid repository.
- Users on Huawei devices running original operating system (EMUI or HarmonyOS) that supports microG should install `com.google.android.gms-250932030-hw.apk` and `com.android.vending-84022630-hw.apk`. These versions are also distributed through Huawei AppGallery.
- `org.microg.gms-250932030-user.apk` is a development preview for special situations. Do not use it except if you know why.
